# Wild Arms 2 — EN / ES / JP String Map

Source: diff of original US disc vs gadesx Spanish patch v1.01 (CD1).
Offsets are file-relative (into the extracted file). JP column blank until the JP disc is added.
NOTE: some ES strings show truncated where the Spanish text is shorter than the English slot
(the game reads to a terminator; trailing English bytes remain as slack).

Total translated strings: 21413
